changelog: - **Estimated monthly value of a funnel record, and its month-by-month series** (#2422, story #2393). New `RelationValue` table (1:1 with `MentorshipRelation`, `relationId` as its id, cascade on delete, registered in `TENANT_MODELS`): `valueMinor` INTEGER minor units + `currency` (ISO 4217, closed two-decimal list, default EUR) + `source` (MANUAL | IMPORT). A table rather than two columns on the relation — the one deviation from the issue text — because dozens of read paths `include` every relation scalar for its mentee, company user and source (#1801); a row nobody `include`s leaks on none of them. New pure `src/lib/dealValue.ts`: `valueByMonth()` rebuilds every month from `StatusChange` (never today's `pipelineStatus`) into {newly won, lost after winning, held at month end}, each with a count, the summed estimate and how many had none; won/churn are `retentionTriangle`'s definition (pinned against it in a unit test), keys from `outcomeStageKeysFrom().finished/.offPath`; transfer chains (`previousRelationId`) are folded into one journey valued by its tip (the newest link, even once its estimate is cleared — a transfer copies the row, so the predecessor's old copy must not come back), so a handover is neither a second win nor a double book entry. Money rules are `src/lib/roi.ts`'s (`isMoney`/`normaliseCurrency`/`CURRENCY_RE` now exported): integers only, a float is refused, and a window that mixes currencies returns the typed `mixed_currency` error instead of a total. Writers: `GET/PUT /api/mentorship/[id]/value` (record owner or ADMIN, `pipeline` capability, 404 outside a vertical with deal values, audited as `deal.value_changed`); the marketing import's `mrr` column gap-fills it through `planFieldUpdates` (overwrites only with `--authoritative`); `transferMentorship()` copies it to the successor in the same transaction. UI: a `DealValuePanel` on `/sales/leads/[id]` and on `/admin/candidates/[id]` (renders nothing for INTERNSHIP), and a `DealValueCard` on `/admin/analytics` fed by the new `GET /api/admin/analytics/deal-value` — MARKETING only (`isDealValueEnabled`: pipeline without mentorship, the `/sales` rule). Every label says estimated/tahmini/geschätzt, since pricing is usage-based. `parseMinorUnits` moved from `marketingImport.ts` to `money.ts` (re-exported) and `formatMinorAmount()` added there; `features.ts` gains a `withoutCapability` tag and a shared `isFeatureShown()` filter for the new `dealValue` card. Amounts use each record's CURRENT estimate (not historised), so re-estimating restates past months' amounts while their counts stay fixed — said on the card and pinned by a test. The editor refuses an ambiguous amount (one separator + exactly three digits, `49,999`) as `ambiguous_amount`; a PUT without `currency` keeps the stored one; the import refuses an `mrr` above the 10M bound per row and compares amount AND currency. Tests: `scripts/test/deal-value.test.mjs` (18), gap-fill/currency/bound cases in `marketing-import.test.mjs`, and `e2e/deal-value.spec.ts` covers the transfer copy and the importer's real writes.

en: Sales records can now carry an estimated monthly value, and the analytics page shows month by month what was won, what was lost and the estimated monthly value of the accounts you hold.
tr: Satış kayıtlarına artık tahmini bir aylık değer girilebiliyor; analiz sayfası ay ay neyin kazanıldığını, neyin kaybedildiğini ve elde tutulan hesapların tahmini aylık değerini gösteriyor.
de: Vertriebsdatensätze können jetzt einen geschätzten Monatswert tragen, und die Analyseseite zeigt Monat für Monat, was gewonnen und was verloren wurde und wie viel die gehaltenen Accounts geschätzt pro Monat wert sind.
